changelog.title: Update Download Persistence
changelog.description: Retains downloaded update APKs across app restarts and navigation, immediately showing 'Install Update' without re-downloading.

changelog.title: Post-Install Storage Cleanup
changelog.description: Automatically deletes leftover update APKs from the cache once updated, saving valuable device storage.

changelog.title: Tokenless Spotify Scraper
changelog.description: Import Spotify playlists, albums, and songs completely login-free and token-free (tokens are now strictly reserved for Canvas).

changelog.title: Audio Pipeline Telemetry Fix
changelog.description: Corrected full-screen audio pipeline dialog metrics to accurately reflect bit-depth, sample rate, decoder engine, and bit-exact passthrough verdict.

changelog.title: Adaptive Navigation Insets
changelog.description: Update info and action buttons adapt seamlessly above 3-button navigation bars and gesture navigation bars without clipping or overlap.

changelog.title: Crash & Installation Fixes
changelog.description: Resolved startup crashes, fixed update install errors, and validated zero error logs across Android 7.0 through Android 16.

additionalNotes: To get the best from Obsidian, please keep your device up to date and regularly check for software updates.
